description: This PHP source file appears to be a core part of a test management/reporting system (particularly for TestLink), responsible for generating and displaying test results in various formats, including spreadsheets. It contains logic for initializing parameters, managing GUI components, building spreadsheet reports, and processing test execution metrics. The file references external libraries and internal modules related to testplan metrics, configuration, and display management.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A templating class for Smarty templates used for rendering HTML reports.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: A class responsible for managing metrics related to test plans, including fetching execution status and platform data.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates request parameters and environmental settings, returning an object with arguments for processing.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has rights on a specific project or test plan, returning a boolean.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Builds and returns an email configuration object for notifications.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI components, labels, and configuration for the report view, returning a tuple with GUI object, labels, and configuration.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates a spreadsheet report of test results using PhpSpreadsheet library, including styling and file download.

methods.name: setUpBuilds
methods.description: Prepares build sets based on input arguments and GUI state for processing test results.

methods.name: buildSpreadsheetData
methods.description: Populates spreadsheet data matrix with test execution metrics, decoding IDs and status labels.
